dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hello? I have a problem ... someone is trying to get into my house through the back door.
{ADDRESS?} Where do you live?
I live at [[ADDRESS]].
I live at 243 1st street
I live at 756 Long street
I live at 391 9th street
{WHAT HAPPENED?} So tell me what's happening?
It's probably that crazy Ray, my ex-boyfriend ... I heard knocking at the door. He's probably drunk again. God, what should I do?
{ANY WEAPON?} I am sending the police right now. Is it possible that Ray has a weapon?
Yes, he usually carries a knife . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . oh my God! He broke down the door! What should I do?!
{HIDE YOURSELF} Hang on for a sec ok? I want you to find a room that you can lock the door on. And then get in there shut it and lock it ok?
Ok . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . God, he knows I'm here!
{POLICE ARE ON THE WAY}Hold on, I know you can do this, police are on their way.
What should I do ?! I have my father's gun ... should I shoot him?
{SHOOT HIM} You have to defend yourself the best way you can. I can't let him hurt you.
{DON'T SHOOT} No! Do not shoot him! Put down the gun. The police will be there shortly, nothing's gonna happen to you.
{IT'S YOUR CALL} I cannot tell you what to do, you have to decide alone... but remember - the law allows you to self-defense in your own home!
Sure, I will! Ray! Ray, get the fuck out of my house, because I will shoot! I tell you! . . . . . . . . . . . Aaaah! I think I killed him! I killed him!!! RAAAY !!!
Oh... I'll put the weapon down. Ray!!! . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Ray, calm down, stop! STOP!!! AAAHH!!
. . . . . Ray! Ray, I have a gun! Please stop! Ray, I will shoot you! Get away from the door . . . . . . . . . . . I think I calmed him down. Come here quickly!
What should I do? Please send someone!
Please DO SOMETHING!

reportElement.texten: Attacker was deadly shot by flat owner.
Armed attacker injured the flat owner with knife.
After being scared of fire arm attacker began escape. Officers pursued and captured the attacker.
